description: Election Commission - S. Y. M. Saleemdeen was selected as the member of the Matale Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Matale Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the nomination and declaration of a new council member following a vacancy due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and local authority member appointments, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
